summary:
All three reviewer findings were real, and I fixed all three. I rejected none.

SFQ-RV-1 (medium, Library check for an unconfigured R2 never fires): I confirmed it. With R2 unset, the real presigner in backend/src/lib/storage.ts signs a URL for the host `servd-media.undefined.r2.cloudflarestorage.com`, because the S3 client puts the bucket in the host name. The old pattern doesn't match that host. I changed presignedWithoutAccount() in frontend/admin/src/components/storefront/LibraryPanel.tsx to `/(^|\.)(undefined|null)\.r2\.cloudflarestorage\.com$/i`. It matches undefined/null hosts with or without a bucket label, and does not match real account hosts, `notundefined.…` or `….r2.cloudflarestorage.com.evil.com`. I checked this against the real presigner output. The Library now also turns an ApiError with code STORAGE_NOT_CONFIGURED from GET /media/upload-url into the single 'storage not configured' message. That handling is ready for later: backend/src/modules/media/routes.ts is outside my file list, so the API doesn't send that 503 yet.

SFQ-RV-2 (medium, narrow rows in the Brand Editor): I confirmed it. /marketing/brands calls GET /concepts?includeInactive=1, so marketing and brand_manager were getting narrow rows that look like wiped brands. CRM campaigns and other ['concepts'] pages were exposed the same way. Fix in backend/src/modules/concepts/routes.ts: the Storefront view is now opt-in with `?view=storefront`, on both GET /concepts and GET /concepts/:id. It returns the narrow STOREFRONT_CONCEPT_SELECT rows (active brands only, scoped through scopeTenantWhere 'read') to roles holding the 'storefront' module and to management. Plain GET /concepts works as before: full rows for MANAGERS, till rows for CASHIERS (the FOH-01 behaviour is unchanged), and 403 for everyone else. So the Brand Editor never gets a narrow row. No write was widened. On the admin side, frontend/admin/src/lib/content.ts gains contentApi.brands() and STOREFRONT_BRANDS_KEY = ['concepts','storefront']. ListPanels, Builder (pop-up targeting) and the LibraryPanel brand picker use them, so the narrow rows also stay out of the shared ['concepts'] cache. I removed the `api` imports from Builder and ListPanels, which were now unused.

SFQ-RV-3 (low, CEO can't approve an unsubmitted draft): I confirmed it. The API approves 'draft' on purpose (siteLayouts/routes.ts:442-452). In frontend/admin/src/components/storefront/Builder.tsx, Approve again shows for admin whenever there is a saved draft or local edits. It is disabled only when there is neither, or when the row is pending or scheduled and there are unsaved edits (approveBlocked). onApprove calls ensureSaved() unless approveBlocked. A plain or rejected draft, or the CEO's own edits, therefore saves and then publishes in one step, as before. The untouched-page 404 fix (hasSavedDraft) is kept. ApproveDialog shows 'Your changes are saved into the draft first.' when it will save. One limit: the edit endpoint doesn't return submittedById, so the editor can't tell a self-submitted draft from someone else's. Any pending or scheduled draft with unsaved edits blocks Approve, and the tooltip tells the CEO to discard his edits or save them first. Reject still shows only for pending or scheduled drafts.

I made no changes to backend/src/index.ts, jsonBody.ts, sections.ts, Providers.tsx or emptyJsonBody.test.ts. I did not commit, push, run next build or touch production.
tests: Admin `tsc --noEmit` exits 0. Backend tsc shows no errors in the touched files. I ran vitest against a private throwaway DB (servd_test_sfqrv, created with prisma db push and dropped afterwards) and local Redis. tests/storefrontQuickfix.test.ts passes 16/16, tests/emptyJsonBody.test.ts 9/9, and the regression checks tests/auditTillUi.test.ts 8/8 and tests/brandReconcile.test.ts 18/18. New and changed tests in storefrontQuickfix: the marketing, brand_manager, two-company, denied-module and retired-brand cases now go through ?view=storefront. New: plain GET /concepts, ?includeInactive=1 and /:id stay 403 for marketing and brand_manager (RV-2). New: management gets the narrow Storefront list scoped to its own company. New for RV-1: with the R2 env cleared, getSignedUploadUrl produces host `servd-media.undefined.r2.cloudflarestorage.com`; the new pattern matches it and the old one doesn't; configured hosts aren't flagged. RV-3 is frontend-only and the admin has no test runner, so it is covered by tsc only, with no automated test.
needsOtherFiles: Optional follow-up for RV-1: backend/src/modules/media/routes.ts (GET /media/upload-url) should refuse with 503 STORAGE_NOT_CONFIGURED when R2_ACCOUNT_ID, R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID or R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY is unset. The Library already handles that code. For a stricter RV-3 rule ('blocked only when submitted by someone else'), backend/src/modules/siteLayouts/routes.ts editShape() would need to return submittedById.
